success.description: You begin chanting the Saga of Gazul, tempering yourself against fear and terror.

boon.description: Your dwarf allies within Medium range recover 1 stress.

conservative.requirements: You may only be under the effects of Saga at a time. When you play a Saga card, return any other Saga cards you have in play to your hand. Effect: While this card is recharging, you reduce the difficulty of all Fear and Terror checks you make by 1.

success.description: You begin chanting the Saga of Gazul, tempering yourself against fear and terror.

boon.description: Your dwarf allies within Medium range recover 1 stress.

reckless.requirements: Special: You may only be under the effect of one Saga at a time. When you play a Saga card, return any other Saga cards you have in play to your hand. Effect: While this card is recharging, you suffer 1 less stress and 1 less fatigue from failed Fear and Terror checks, to a minimum of 0.
